summary: Clicking an agent-written .html file (its card under the Write call, or its inline file chip) opens it in a sandboxed preview as a third right-pane mode beside the terminal and the IDE: one reused webview in its own session, no Node, no popups, no navigation off the file and no network beyond the file's own folder, with live reload, a page theme and width menu, and the console's errors and blocked requests.

reactNativeIos.reason: The preview is a desktop pane: it needs an Electron webview in its own session with a request filter, a custom protocol and a folder watch, none of which the phone app has. Rendering agent-written HTML on a phone would need a separate sandbox design (a locked-down WebView with no bridge), so it is out of scope here; the phone keeps showing the file path as text.

nativeAndroid.reason: Same as the iOS app: there is no right pane and no sandboxed webview session on Android. The chat shows the path as text, unchanged.

storageDataMigration.reason: Nothing is stored in the database. The preview session is an in-memory partition, the right-pane 'preview' mode is never persisted (a restart returns to the terminal or the IDE), and the only saved value is the dismissed sandbox notice in renderer localStorage.

automated: tests/unit/html-preview-sandbox.test.ts: the controller blocks http, https, wss, loopback, file and other-scheme requests and reports them; a page from a previous open is refused; window.open is denied; navigation to another URL or another file is cancelled; the server returns 404 for ../, encoded ../ and backslash escapes, a sibling folder and a symlink out of the folder; remote content is served alone; missing, oversized and non-html files are refused; a burst of writes reloads once and a delete reports the file missing.
tests/unit/files-read-html.test.ts: files:read-html returns only .html files inside the repo and refuses escapes, other kinds and files over the 5 MB cap.
tests/unit/html-preview-open.test.ts: targets, paths, the right-pane mode round trip, CSP report parsing and console text.

e2e/html-preview.e2e.mjs against the real Electron sandbox: the demo agent writes the page, the card opens the pane in partition sb-html-preview, and a probe page written over it (live reload) fails to fetch the internet and loopback, fails to read ../secret.txt, an encoded ../ and a file:// URL, gets null from window.open, sees no require, process or window.api, and still loads assets/ok.css beside it. No new BrowserWindow appears, a deleted file shows File not found, and Close removes the webview.
hardware: Run on this Mac (darwin arm64) in a background Electron window through the e2e script above.
notExercised: Remote chats: the renderer reads the file through files:read-html on the machine's backend and loads it as content, but no live remote session was previewed. A remote page has no live reload (there is no local folder to watch) and loads no relative assets; Reload reads it again.
The legacy SWITCHBOARD_BACKEND_URL mode (the whole app on one remote backend) previews only files that exist on this desktop.
Windows and Linux were not run; the paths are built with the root's own separator and the folder watch uses fs.watch.
